name: アカウント切替ボトムシート
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0018 アカウント切替ボトムシート.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE complete compact account-switch bottom sheet from source region8,398,374,430 normalized. Preserve exact Japanese content: centered title アカウント; account row 現在のアカウント with horizontal three-dot menu at right; first workspace avatar灯, ライトハウスのスペース / 標準プラン; second avatar学, 学びのスペース / 無料プラン, SELECTED with check at far right; creation row 新しいスペース; lower two actions 別のアカウントを追加 and ログアウト. Top centered short neutral drag handle. Lock typography from saved mock: title Meiryo Bold14/24, names/action14/24 Regular400, metadata12/16 Regular400, account descriptor12/16 Regular400, tracking0. ORIGINAL source controls fine details: small RED ROUNDED-SQUARE badge1 overlaps firstavatar upper-right; circle enclosing plus glyph on BOTH creation and add-account rows; red circle enclosing X beside ログアウト. Do not copy mock omissions of badge/circle wrappers/action icons or black destructive label. White outlined avatars with slate initials, no mint. Second-row simple check forest green. Preserve destructive logout accent red#C65F52 glyph and label, notification badge darker red#B8473E with white1. All other utility glyphs slate#526173 and text ink. White sheet and white groups, fine neutral borders and soft shadows enough to distinguish them without broad gray/mint fill. Source rounded sheet anatomy, compact stacked grouping, restrained gap before lower actions and subtle divider between add/log-out. No outer screen scrim, phone chrome, personal email or background workspace page; this is the standalone sheet component. Render readable portrait around1200x1500, uniformly enlarged from374px logical width with restrained pure-white margins. Keep all actual controls/states.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Restore purposeful original red accents for count and logout. Selected workspace check forest green; other utilities slate and all surfaces pure white, no mint avatars.
reviewNotes: 原版/crop/mockを目視しnative文字階層確認。mock欠落のred角丸badge1、作成/追加の丸plus、logout赤丸Xとredlabelを原版から復元。mintavatarとgray面は白へ。生成後に9日本語run、handle/ellipsis、secondselection、すべてのaction/glyph、赤通知/破棄と緑選択の意味を目視確認。font同一性/操作/native編集/所有者承認未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
